definitions.explanation: The fixed amount of time allowed for something — an exam, a game, a speech, a parking space, an all-you-can-eat meal. Formed from {制限|せいげん} (restriction) + {時間|じかん} (time).

examples.japanese: {制限時間|せいげんじかん}は{九十分|きゅうじゅっぷん}です。
examples.english: The time limit is ninety minutes.

examples.japanese: {制限時間内|せいげんじかんない}に{全問|ぜんもん}{答|こた}えられなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't answer all the questions within the time limit.

examples.japanese: この{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}は{制限時間|せいげんじかん}が{二時間|にじかん}に{決|き}まっている。
examples.english: This all-you-can-eat has a fixed two-hour time limit.

examples.japanese: {発表|はっぴょう}の{制限時間|せいげんじかん}を{超|こ}えてしまい、{最後|さいご}まで{話|はな}せなかった。
examples.english: I went over the time limit for my presentation and couldn't finish what I wanted to say.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {制限時間|せいげんじかん}を{設|もう}ける: to set a time limit
- {制限時間内|せいげんじかんない}に: within the time limit
- {制限時間|せいげんじかん}を{超|こ}える: to exceed the time limit
- {制限時間|せいげんじかん}が{切|き}れる: for the time limit to run out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {締|し}め{切|き}り: deadline — a point in time by which something is due, not a duration
- {期限|きげん}: term, expiry — a longer official validity period, as on a contract or a passport
